data_window: 2026-08-27 00:00 to 2026-08-30 12:20 Asia/Shanghai. GitHub Search API queries covered AI agent, MCP agent, browser agent, code agent, RAG agent, voice agent, AI assistant, copilot agent, AI workflow, LLM app, automation agent and active recently pushed repositories. Raw responses were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_30_*.json; selected README audits were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_30_readmes/.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on main...origin/main. Pre-existing unrelated frontend/deploy dirty files and old untracked data/runs/2026-08-19-lark-message.md were preserved unstaged. Discovery used unauthenticated GitHub Search API metadata and selected README raw downloads. README fetching later hit unauthenticated GitHub API rate limits for several lower-ranked candidates. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, desktop-tested, mobile-tested, MCP-handshake-tested, credential-tested, provider-tested, payment-tested, security-scanned or deployed.
trend_observations: The strongest new cluster is not generic chatbots but operational control layers around agents: model gateways, durable coworker sessions, execution recovery, usage/cost ledgers, phone/browser/GUI bridges, multimodal memory, symbolic memory and build-vs-buy guardrails. The center of gravity moved from single-agent demos toward auditable boundaries around real work: credentials, approvals, event logs, local execution, cost, rollback and human takeover.
assumptions: Scores are editorial point-in-time rankings based on GitHub Search API metadata, README evidence, visible product surface, install/build cues, documentation completeness, repository freshness and AI-native workflow depth. Stars/forks are unauthenticated API snapshots, not exact growth deltas. README claims were not independently runtime-verified. Mature platforms, pure prompt or skill collections, paper-first research repos, thin Windows utilities, marketing-only repos and projects without clear runnable surfaces were downgraded or skipped. The prior automation memory has no completed 2026-08-28 or 2026-08-29 public run, so this run advances the committed dataset from 2026-08-26 to 2026-08-30.

top_projects.ai_native_angle: Separates worker-agent execution from recovery control, giving agent loops an explicit evidence gate instead of relying on the same model to judge itself.
top_projects.growth_signal: GitHub Search API snapshot showed 97 stars; created and pushed 2026-08-28, updated 2026-08-29. README includes schema, CLI/server examples, integration guidance, benchmark caveats and training receipt.

top_projects.recommended_action: Use the trajectory schema as a design reference now; test the controller on synthetic false-completion traces before adopting its model output.
